## Part 1: Set up the equations
Let $x$ be the price of one taco and $y$ be the price of one burrito, in dollars. Ana's receipt gives
$$4x+3y=32 \tag{1}$$
Ben's receipt is $37, not $5:
$$2x+5y=37 \tag{2}$$

## Part 2: Solve and verify
Multiply (2) by $2$:
$$4x+10y=74$$
Subtract (1):
$$\begin{aligned}(4x+10y)-(4x+3y)&=74-32\\7y&=42\\y&=6\end{aligned}$$
Put $y=6$ into (1):
$$\begin{aligned}4x+3(6)&=32\\4x+18&=32\\4x&=14\\x&=3.50\end{aligned}$$
So tacos cost $3.50 and burritos cost $6.00. Verification: Ana pays $4(3.50)+3(6)=14+18=32$ and Ben pays $2(3.50)+5(6)=7+30=37$, exactly as required.
